prompt_condition_secondary: E3 neutral prompt, only if E3 preflight passed

popqa.label: y=1 wrong, y=0 correct; abstain and ambiguous excluded

positions.secondary: suf-1 (Lavi et al.; logit read-out site)

layers.secondary: train-source-selected layer by inner grouped CV on the training source only

estimators.primary: dom (difference of means, unit-normalised; same family as r_hat)
estimators.secondary: L2 logistic (C chosen on training source)

extra_row: r_hat (registered Stage 4 direction) evaluated on every test source

cell_rules.off_diagonal: train on the full training source (syn: train split); evaluate on the full test source (syn: test split)
cell_rules.diagonal: grouped 5-fold CV within the source (syn: train split -> test split)

metrics.auroc_probe: AUROC of the probe score on the test source
metrics.auroc_logit: AUROC of the logit baseline on the test source: primary = log_odds over Unknown token IDs; secondary = -maxp
metrics.incremental: cross-fitted stacking on the test source: [log_odds, maxp, entropy] vs [+ probe score]; probe score fixed (trained on another source) so no leakage; diagonal uses nested stacking (E1 engine)
metrics.auroc_text: TF-IDF (word 1-2 grams, min_df=2) L2 logistic trained on the training source's user prompt text, evaluated on the test source; diagonal by grouped CV

pre_declared_ceiling_note: Under the registered prompt, auroc_logit on contextual test sources is expected to be near 1; delta in those columns is ceiling-limited and is interpreted only via the incremental test and the secondary (neutral) prompt condition.
